messages.subject: Fitting Fitting Locally adaptive spatial smoothing using conditional autoregressive models.
parts:
Hi INLA experts,

I am wondering if we could use INLA to fit the locally adaptive spatial smoothing conditional autoregressive model, which has been proposed by Duncan Lee in 2013 (the paper used INLA to fit the model). Any suggestions would be appreciated.

Many thanks!
Best,
Alex

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fitting Fitting Locally adaptive spatial smoothing using conditional autoregressive models.
parts:
HI,
I just had a quick look at the paper, and it uses an iterated sequence
of INLA estimations. If there's code available from Duncan it would
probably need some minor updates to work with the updated INLA package
versions, but the method itself should be fine, I think.

I don't see a repo for the 2013 paper on his gihub page, but you could
try contacting him directly to ask if he can share the old code (it
may even be in a supplement on the journal webpage, but I came across
the paper on JSTOR, so I'm not sure):
https://www.gla.ac.uk/schools/mathematicsstatistics/staff/duncanlee/

Finn
